title: FBN Reimbursement Postings and Bank-Returned Payouts, Northloop Payments
content:
**Rule.** An FBN reimbursement is credited to the Northloop Payments balance in full on its reimbursement date and is never reserved; when the reimbursed units are later found, the same amount is taken back. A payout returned by the bank is credited back to the balance on the return date and the account is placed on hold until new bank details are verified.

| Event | Balance effect | Date | Further effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| FBN reimbursement | credited in full, never reserved | the reimbursement date | none |
| Reimbursed units later found | the same amount taken back | — | none |
| Payout returned by the bank | credited back to the balance | the return date | account placed on hold until new bank details are verified |

*Hypothetical example.* An FBN reimbursement of 180.00 USD is credited in full on its reimbursement date and is payable, since none of it is reserved; if the units are found later, 180.00 USD is taken back. A scheduled payout of 900.00 USD returned by the bank comes back as a 900.00 USD credit on the return date, and the account goes on hold until new bank details are verified.
